description: A waveshaper that wraps its input with a modulo operation, folding anything above the setting back down

params.text: Sets the level of the wrapped signal, silent at the far left and twice unity at the far right
Sets the value the signal is wrapped against, 0.01 at the far left for heavy folding and 1 at the far right for light folding
Sets the balance between the untouched input and the wrapped signal

inputs.text: The signal to be wrapped, one channel

outputs.text: The wrapped signal mixed with the dry input, one channel

notes: the module adds nothing to Rack's right-click menu
